description: The public entity card (schema rokha.entity/1) for any object on Rokha — a page, a rig, a skill, a harness record of any type (skill, instruction, knowledge, data), a sub-rig, a Forge agent, an MCP server, a product: identity, owner, images, description, interface (inputs/outputs/how to invoke), attached sources, proof (proven, uses, last run), the token a third-party launchpad created for it (mint, launchpad, market data; not endorsed by Rokha) and its added agent.

id.description: a page/agent handle, a listing slug, or a record/product uuid

kind.description: any registered kind (GET /api/entities/kinds): page, rig, skill, harness, mcp, agent, product, harness_record (any harness type), rig_record (any rig or sub-rig)

name: entity_get
title: Entity Get
